---
title: "embedpdf page option"
---

Three embeds of `sample.pdf`, a PDF of 2 pages. The first two ask for page 2.
In a desktop browser with a built-in PDF viewer, the viewer shows them as an
`<iframe>`, which opens at page 2 in Chromium, Firefox, and Safari. The third
asks for no page and stays an `<object>`. On iPhone, iPad, and Android, the
first embed uses PDF.js and the other two stay `<object>`s. The checks in
`tests/` read these embeds.
